decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The proposed roof extensions, including side and rear dormers, by reason of their excessive size, bulk and appearance would be disproportionately large in relation to the roof and constitute an obtrusive feature which would be out of character with and harmful to the appearance of the house and the established roofline of the adjoining properties and the street scene generally contrary to policies ENV- B 1.1 and H 6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2. The proposed roof extensions, including side and rear dormers, by reason of their excessive size, when taken together with the other existing extensions and structures at the property would constitute an over development of the site contrary to policies ENV- B 1.1 and H 6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a roof extension to house.
